name: leptonica
description: Image processing and image analysis library

repo.name: leptonica
repo.description: Leptonica is an open source library containing software that is broadly useful for image processing and image analysis applications. The official github repository for Leptonica is: danbloomberg/leptonica.  See leptonica.org for more documentation.

readme.summary: The README effectively describes what Leptonica does but lacks any code examples, API usage guidance, or getting-started content beyond a vcpkg install snippet.
readme.top_issue: No quick-start or code examples showing how to actually use the library after installation.

common_complaints: File path handling with quotes fails on Windows
File format parsing issues (PBM whitespace, multipage TIFF loops)
Missing support for modern image formats (JPEG XL since 2023)
Build system compatibility issues (lib vs lib64 paths)
sentiment.summary: Mixed health: active bug resolution on recent issues, but 3-year-old feature requests remain open, and unmoderated spam/placeholder issues suggest moderate maintenance attention.

red_flags: Some responses could be perceived as dismissive of user concerns, especially regarding the handling of double quotes in filenames.
There is a lack of encouragement for new contributors beyond acknowledging their contributions.
communication.summary: The maintainer responses provide detailed technical explanations and address specific issues with some helpfulness, but they can sometimes come across as dismissive or lacking in patience towards repeated questions.

concerns: 70 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months indicates issue backlog is accumulating
Zero commits in past 6 months despite issue activity
No active contributors in past 6 months
No PR activity or merges in 6 months
positive_signals: Very recent commit (15 days ago) suggests project is not completely abandoned
maintenance.summary: Package shows signs of stalled maintenance with significant unresolved issue backlog, no contributor activity, and inconsistent recent commit activity.
